title: Count Positions on Street With Required Brightness
goal: Count street positions meeting their individual brightness requirements.
strategy: Each light adds one across a clipped interval. A difference array records only interval boundaries, and its prefix sum gives the brightness at every street position.

phasePurposes.start: Count street positions meeting their individual brightness requirements.

phasePurposes.update: Each light adds one across a clipped interval. A difference array records only interval boundaries, and its prefix sum gives the brightness at every street position.
phasePurposes.done: Count street positions meeting their individual brightness requirements.

edgeCases: No lights still meets zero requirements
A large radius is clipped to both street ends
A zero-radius light affects only its own position
